title: 上方保护完整双人景
description: 木版画用强轮廓呈现攀爬者、主绳、锚点与专注保护者。

art_direction.medium: hand-painted oil illustration with restrained impasto
art_direction.scene: Create an original woodcut-style illustration of a fictional adult following a compact easy indoor top-rope route. Broad violet jugs and positive footholds allow relaxed leg-supported movement. Show a wide scene containing the entire opaque-clothed climber and competent adult belayer, both in correctly fitted waist-and-leg-loop harnesses. The rope ties properly through the climber's designated tie-in points, rises continuously to the overhead anchor, and descends to the belayer's device. The belayer watches attentively and keeps the brake hand down on the brake strand. Use carved navy contours, ivory grain, and restrained orange accents. Keep the floor clear and rope credible. No free solo, writing, logos, or slack loop.
